newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, hoteliers recover.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, hoteliers recover.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Tuesday, with a mild recovery among tourist firms.
* Of 15 active issues, seven were up, four down, three remained flat and one was traded for the first time.
* Turnover was higher at 3.8 million kuna, volume also at 6,772 shares.
* The biggest loser was Zagrebacka Banka 2C-series issue which fell 100 kuna to close at 500, with 11 shares sold.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Laguna rose 50 kuna to close at 1,300, on volume of 104 shares.
* Most actively traded issue was food producer Podravka which sold 2,084 shares at 229 kuna, six up from Friday.
Full report available on page ZAGSTOCK.
